title.narrative: Result-Based Management for Vietnam Education Managers

description.narrative: The purpose of the Grant is to assist the Recipient in enhancing the capacity of its Ministry of Education and Training in providing leadership and guidance on result-based management to various levels of education management. The activities for which the Grant is given are as follows: (a) Survey of Education Management Staff Capacity: (i) conducting a study to assess the education management staff capacity using the currently available database of personnel management; (ii) preparing a questionnaire and conducting a survey of education managers at the levels of schools, district education bureau, provincial education department and Ministry of Education & Training to ascertain: the description of their jobs accountabilities, the motivations for better outcomes in education management, and the process for evaluating the effectiveness of education managers; and (iii) preparing a detailed report on the result of this survey including: description of key tasks of education management, factors identified by management as incentive/disincentive, and current procedures for managers. assessment, through the provision of advisory services, training and workshops. (b) Development of Competency Map for Education Managers: (i) developing a competency map for education managers, including definition of competencies for different levels of managers and different standards of skills and knowledge; and (ii) carry-out detailed consultations with all the provinces on the draft competency map to raise awareness amongst education managers of the concept of result-based management and to build wide support for this concept and prepare grounds for nation wide introduction, through the provision of advisory services and workshops. (c) Assessment of Training needs for Education Managers: (i) conducting an assessment of the training needs of Education Managers, based on the competency map; (ii) conducting a self-assessment of the school and district officers of their competencies to situate them in the context of their job; and (iii) developing a process of prioritizing training needs with respect to: training contents, training modes, and training time, through the provision of advisory services, training and workshops. (d) Provision of Result-based Management Guides to Education Management: developing a detailed Guide which would include: (i) definition of result-based management, (ii) the key competencies that schools, districts and provinces expect from different levels of education managers, (iii) how to conduct self-evaluation, and (iv) identification of training needs and consultation with senior management, through the provision of advisory services and workshops.
